QuestInfo.name: [Beasts of Fury] Tired Pan Zhuan
QuestInfo.0: Pan Zhuan of Mu Lung has a favor to ask.
QuestInfo.1: Pan Zhuan is very worn out from working long days. She says there's a herb that can help her at the Boulder Gorge Training Grounds.
QuestInfo.2: You brought Pan Zhuan some Moonlight Posies, a great herb for treating fatigue. But it gets poisonous soon after being dug up.

default.0: I hear Moonlight Posies are good for fatigue. They grow in the Boulder Gorge Training Ground beyond the dojo. They might be hard to find, but I think you can do it!
